messages:
kelly: FYI partner sync today - AMD pushed ROCm 5.8 beta to a few SI partners and NVIDIA rolled 536.02 into their early-access. Partners flagged a regression in our quantized kernels and some image upgrade automation failed in their marketplace pipelines. Need a quick cross-team decision on pinning vs emergency patch.

diego: Can we get the exact fail logs? vendor-ci-bot: CI report 2026-03-19_11:45: 
```
E       AssertionError: outputs differ at step 14
E       Expected: <tensor shape=(1,1024) dtype=float32)>
E       Found: <tensor shape=(1,1024) dtype=float32)>
```

anna: That smells like deterministic seed/allocator differences but could be kernel math variance in quantized paths. Any repro on baremetal?

kelly: Partners reported fail on GCP Marketplace automated image upgrade job, specifically when the distro's kernel was 5.15.0-70. They had success when downgrading kernel to 5.15.0-67.

paul: Ops note: If we pin images we need to communicate deprecation window. Pin plan: runtime tags redwood/runtime:2026-03-19-gpu-nv535-pin and redwood/runtime:2026-03-19-rocm57-pin. We'll block auto-updates for 72h. ops-bot: Image pinning initiated, TTL 72h.

nvidia-eng: Thanks for the repro. We see similar flakiness in internal tests on 536.x with certain glibc/driver combos. We'll dig into cuBLAS->tensor core fallback paths. Can you provide exact distro package list?

diego: I'll collect package lists and kernel outputs from partner CI. Anna, can you run quantized evals across kernels 5.15.{67,68,69,70}?

anna: On it. I'll spin up matrix and include both ROCm 5.7/5.8 and CUDA 535/536. Expect first results in ~6h.

kelly: Communications: two tracks - (1) private partner note recommending pinned runtime tags and kernel 5.15.0-67; (2) public marketplace advisory with guidance and a rollback path. Diego, you on the partner letters?

diego: Yes. Draft will include repro steps, our recommended pins, and estimated ETA for a hotfix (24-36h).

vendor-ci-bot: Nightly matrix queued: cuda-535/536 x kernels 5.15.{67,68,69,70} x glibc variants.

anna: Early findings: CUDA 536 + kernel 5.15.0-70 shows 0.8% numerical drift in quantized matmul; ROCm 5.8 shows allocator layout change triggering different memory alignment in our packing routine leading to occasional NaN in very long sequences.

paul: Given the risk, recommend we pause marketplace auto-updates and require partners to opt into the new driver versions until we sign-off.

kelly: Agreed. Also, request for partner engs: if you can collect dmesg logs on the failing runs that'd help. Nvidia-eng: can you coordinate with your field SEs? nvidia-eng: Will do, loop in nv-field@nvendor.com.

diego: Technical mitigation work items: 1) Add alignment-safe path in quantized packer (anna) 2) Add allocator-agnostic checksums + guard (paul/chris) 3) Add CI gate for marketplace images that runs matrix above before listing update.

anna: Starting patch for packer now. I'll open draft PR and assign reviewers.

paul: I'm on the checksum guard PR. ETA ~18h. We'll also add a test that injects different allocator offsets to reproduce.

kelly: Timeline summary: today - pin images & notify partners; 24h - hotfix PRs opened; 48h - CI matrix results and canary; 72h - unfreeze decision.

nvidia-eng: We'll prioritize a driver patch if your repro shows a specific kernel/driver interaction. Please share the small case ASAP.

diego: Thanks team. Diego to partners: "We've pinned marketplace images and recommended kernel downgrade to 5.15.0-67 while we validate patches. We'll provide canary results in ~48h."

paul: ops-bot will keep auto-update blocked and log partner approvals.

kelly: Closing loop - update in #partnerships in 48h with canary metrics. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
